text: No cross-sell on cart today; add a 'frequently bought with' block on PDP + cart against the Single SKU pages.
why: More cross-sell adds units per order, which raises AOV — and AOV is a direct multiplier of revenue.

text: Only the Starter Bundle is live; add a 'refill 2-pack' and a 'family 3-pack' and set bundle as the default PDP variant.
why: Bundle adoption raises units per order and AOV; AOV multiplies revenue.

text: No post-purchase upsell exists; add a 1-click refill upsell on the order-status page.
why: Accepted upsells raise AOV without added ad spend; AOV multiplies revenue.

text: The Win-back flow is off; turn on a 45-day lapsed flow with a refill incentive.
why: Reactivating lapsed buyers lifts repeat-purchase rate, which feeds returning revenue and thus total revenue.

text: No Replenishment flow is built; add a 25-day refill reminder flow in Klaviyo.
why: Replenishment shortens time-between-orders and raises LTV, which feeds returning revenue.

text: Cold-Prospecting-Broad runs 4 creatives at frequency 3.4; add 6 UGC hooks and a no-LAL broad audience to refresh delivery and lower CPM.
why: Fresh creative and a broader audience lift cheap reach and new-visitor sessions, which feed sessions, orders, and revenue.
